evidence.summary: Retrieved CDC’s current instructions, amended signed PDF and the Federal Register reproduction of the original October 22 order. Preserved October research supports the historical account. Added a separately dated October 28 amendment update, including crew coverage and a discrepancy in retention instructions.
evidence.limits: Partial automated documentary check, not a full fact-check, human review, clinical assessment or individual travel clearance. Original signed PDF was not recovered as an unchanged October 22 file; its URL now serves an amended document. Current CDC webpage mixes arrival/departure retention descriptions. Reuters live fetch failed; its October 22 claim is supported by the preserved extract only.

publication.approval_scope: Artifacts for explicitly approved recovery batch; no human review, deployment, or public-anchor verification asserted.

uncertainties: CDC signed-PDF URL now serves the October 28 amended order, so it cannot authenticate an unchanged October 22 PDF. Original text reconstructed from the official October 27 Federal Register reproduction.
October 28 amendment expressly covers crew; November 3 effective deadline has passed.
CDC webpage has unresolved arrival-versus-departure retention wording; both descriptions are recorded, with order text distinguished.
